title: Review (Supported): on fresh seed 3 the hop-gating membrane refines the lattice-chem A pattern a little (12.0 vs 13.2 px) and the ringless slow-A twin refines it more (8.9 px)
summary: labkit runs of c19's gated-wall world on seed 3 (128^2, 10000 steps, phi_AW 0.5) in the finding's three arms, measured with c19's domain.py and ringwork.py. A pattern wavelength: gate (gA 3) 12.0 px, no gate 13.2 px, slow-A twin (pA 0.06, no gate) 8.9 px. M rim/core 1.48 / 1.18 / 2.29. Bath A 0.406 / 0.430 / 0.439; food in cells 1.73 / 1.91 / 1.62 vs bath 4.97 / 5.27 / 3.83. Same ordering as the finding: the gate does a little, uniformly slower A does more.

observations.W: domain_s3.txt: wavelength 12.0 (gate) / 13.2 (no gate) / 8.9 px (slow A); rerun/*/seed3/FACTS.md: M rim/core 1.48 / 1.18 / 2.29

controls_run.W: rerun/nogate/seed3 and rerun/slowA/seed3 against rerun/gate/seed3, same seed, grid and duration

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Bath A is slightly lower with the gate here (0.406 vs 0.430), where the finding found it slightly higher (0.46-0.50 vs 0.43): the leak difference is small either way.
